champions.desc: has a time-of-day pattern; leans Down near the top of the hourly range (pullbacks); bets against the btc move, last 4 hours; bets against the btc move, last hour; has a futures-funding-cycle pattern. Partly trusts the market price. Only bets on weekends, only when the market is calm. Needs 2.3¢ of edge to bet.
